scripts.lint: bun run --cwd apps/backend lint && bun run --cwd apps/frontend lint
scripts.dev: bun run --cwd apps/shared build && bunx concurrently "bun run --cwd apps/backend start:dev" "bun run --cwd apps/frontend dev"
scripts.build: bun run --cwd apps/shared build && bun run --cwd apps/backend build && bun run --cwd apps/frontend build
scripts.start: bunx concurrently "bun run --cwd apps/backend start:prod" "bun run --cwd apps/frontend preview"
scripts.db:up: if command -v podman >/dev/null 2>&1 && podman compose version >/dev/null 2>&1; then podman compose up -d; elif command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 && docker compose version >/dev/null 2>&1; then docker compose up -d; else echo 'No supported Compose setup found. Install Podman with podman-compose or Docker with Compose.'; exit 1; fi
scripts.db:down: if command -v podman >/dev/null 2>&1 && podman compose version >/dev/null 2>&1; then podman compose down; elif command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 && docker compose version >/dev/null 2>&1; then docker compose down; else echo 'No supported Compose setup found. Install Podman with podman-compose or Docker with Compose.'; exit 1; fi
scripts.format: bun run --cwd apps/backend format && bun run --cwd apps/frontend format
